20 recorded HTML samples from Mozilla Readability 0.6.0's regression corpus:
4 Chinese (gmw, pixnet, qq, youth), 16 English. No live network is used by tests.
`manifest.json` records upstream paths, SHA-256 and import date. Original recording
 dates are not supplied by upstream and are not claimed here. These are upstream
recordings, not newly recorded production API results. Page content belongs to
its original publisher; retained solely as upstream regression fixtures.

The macOS RunnerTests run each original HTML through the production offscreen
WKWebView parser and compare whitespace-normalized text with upstream expected.html.
The .txt files are extracted from those expected.html files, not generated by our
parser. Dart tests separately check Markdown structure, stable IDs and sanitation.
Mozilla's parser license: packages/mm_platform/assets/readability/LICENSE.md.
